title: Split renderer.ts under the 600-line limit
notes: src/renderer/renderer.ts is at 610 code lines after PR #220 (was 612), over the 600-line ceiling in the user's file-size rule, and it is meant to be wiring only (workflow-rule-2). Split along its real seams (each wiring group that sets up one feature: a feature's handlers and listeners move beside that feature as a create<Feature>Wiring(ports) function), not by moving arbitrary lines. Count code lines, not comments. No behaviour change; checks green; note the before/after counts in the PR. main.ts is at 599, so leave it alone unless the same seam applies.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #222: pane output, exit and working-report listeners to panes/pane-output-wiring.ts; board file listener to board/board-wiring.ts; notes and ink listeners to notes/notes-wiring.ts, each with a test. renderer.ts 610 -> 583 code lines; main.ts left at 599. No behaviour change. Hand check in the app not yet done.
